---
title: "About"
---

I am the **John L. and Helen Kellogg Professor of Finance** at the Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University, and a **Research Associate** of the National Bureau of Economic Research.

My research examines the interaction between **technological innovation and financial markets**, including intangible capital, economic growth, innovation, macroeconomics, and asset pricing. I am currently a **Co-Editor** of the *Journal of Financial Economics*.

**Education:** Ph.D. in Financial Economics, MIT (2007); M.Sc. in Finance and Economics, LSE (2001); B.A. in Economics and Finance, University of Piraeus (2000).
